content.title: About
content.content: Water NFS is a pure drinking water obtained through reverse osmosis and enhanced mineralization. The product contains no calories, sugar, or artificial additives, providing optimal hydration for the body.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Water NFS undergoes triple filtration: carbon filter, membrane osmosis, and UV treatment.
Mineralization adds calcium, magnesium and potassium in natural ratios.
The PET bottle is fully recyclable and meets international food‑grade safety standards.
Produced according to GOST 31971‑2012, guaranteeing the absence of microbiological contaminants.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: Regular consumption of pure water helps maintain fluid balance, essential for all physiological processes.

items.title: Reduces kidney load
items.content: Lack of sugar and artificial additives lowers the risk of kidney stone formation.

items.title: Maintains electrolyte balance
items.content: Minerals such as calcium and magnesium support normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Aids weight control
items.content: Water contains no calories, so replacing sugary drinks with it can help lower overall dietary calorie intake.

items.title: Improves skin condition
items.content: Adequate water intake helps keep skin hydrated and assists in toxin elimination.

items.title: Overconsumption
items.content: Drinking excessive amounts of water can lead to hyponatremia – dilution of blood sodium levels.

items.title: Allergy to additives
items.content: Some individuals may react to the added minerals, although such cases are rare.

items.title: Plastic containers
items.content: When stored for long periods in hot conditions, plastic may release microscopic particles; store in a cool place.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Water NFS is best consumed plain, chilled or at room temperature. It works well as a base for herbal teas, smoothies, and sports drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, it is recommended to consume within 3‑5 days.
